Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd., doing business as DeepSeek, is a Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) company that is known for releasing open-weight large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems designed for low-cost inference and high efficiency. Based in Hangzhou, China, DeepSeek is owned and funded by High-Flyer, a Chinese hedge fund.
DeepSeek was founded in July 2023 by Liang Wenfeng, who also serves as CEO. It launched an eponymous chatbot alongside its DeepSeek-R1 model in January 2025. Since January 2025, the company offers external users an open license for model parameters, while not offering an open license to training data. According to The New York Times, the company recruits AI (and other fields) researchers from top Chinese universities to broaden its models' knowledge and capabilities.
